cutting out unnecessary subtext and details and subtitles in the most random places (example: "Designed with Monochromatic Architectural Principles")
Every element of the website being thoughtfully designed, carefully placed, existing for a purpose that improves the user experience positively - not just sitting there for no reason - everything should be meaningful - this does not mean excessively over engineered, the website needs to feel like a pleasant experience and not like navigating through technical jargon and overcrowded chunks of information - not cluttered beyond reason.

avoid using pills to highlight things - there are better and simpler ways to do so
reiterating - not everything needs a subtitle or explicit explanation
